## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

A fox rests at a log. The sun is hot. Fox naps in the dim spot by the log. At dusk, the fox runs.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, d, e, f, g

**Rules in this story:**

**Rule 22:** 3rd person singular verbs

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

It runs in the grass. It runs past a pond. Fox digs in the mud. It digs a big den.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, b, d, e, f

**Rules in this story:**

**Rule 22:** 3rd person singular verbs

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

The den is snug. In the den, six cubs sit. The cubs are soft and red, just like mom. Mom fox sits with the cubs.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** b, c, d, e, f

**Rules in this story:**

**Rule 14:** Double consonant for vowel suffix

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

The cubs nap in the den. The log is not just a log. It is the top of a fox den!

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

## Think About It

1. What does the fox do at the log? (Rests in the dim spot.)
2. When does the fox run? (At dusk.)
3. What does the fox dig in the mud? (A big den.)
4. What sits in the den with mom fox? (Six cubs — soft and red like mom.)
